description: Build an n=512 CTA-cluster megakernel: one panel-owner CTA recursively factors 8+8+16 or 16+16 FP32 micro-panels and publishes V plus Gram-and-tau T-inverse data through DSM, while sibling CTAs tcgen05-tile far updates and synchronize once per blocked panel, preserving per-matrix conditioning routes and TF32x3 accuracy.
4-CTA n512 DSM cluster megakernel with recursive 16+16 FP32 panels; lazy NVRTC compile failed because stdint.h is unavailable
NVRTC-self-contained 4-CTA cluster kernel compiled and standard tests passed, but diff_correctness_guard hit cudaErrorIllegalAddress on benchmark n512 batch640
Correct 4-CTA DSM cluster megakernel with 16+16 FP32 panel and Gram/tau block update; dense n512 measured 262515.289 us and full geomean 1800.168153 us
Replicated owner V/Tinv from DSM once per panel into sibling shared memory; dense n512 improved 262515.289 to 117188.309 us, geomean 1800.168153 to 1685.613054 us
TF32x3 WMMA far-update tiles compiled, but in-place negated Tinv solve used the wrong recurrence sign; diff guard flagged all dense n512 inputs
